project_type: VGUI1 UI library for Xash3D game engine (vgui_support module)
build_system: CMake - file(GLOB src/*.cpp) auto-discovers new source files. Static library by default, shared with -DVGUI_BUILD_SHARED=ON
test_framework: No unit tests - verification is compile-only
verification_instructions: Build with cmake and verify zero compiler errors/warnings. The file(GLOB) pattern auto-picks up new .cpp files after re-running cmake.
environment_constraints: C++11 standard only. Must use 'null' not 'nullptr'. Must compile with GCC and NDK Clang (aarch64-linux-android21). No STL headers beyond what existing code uses (stdlib.h, string.h, stddef.h).
contribution_requirements: All new files in /projects/sandbox/mainui_cpp/vgui1/src/. Headers in /projects/sandbox/mainui_cpp/vgui1/include/. Follow existing naming conventions: PascalCase files, VGUI_ prefix for headers.
key_patterns: All classes in namespace vgui. Controls inherit Panel. Signals are abstract classes (ActionSignal, IntChangeSignal) with virtual callbacks. Dar<T> is the dynamic array template. Use drawSetColor/drawFilledRect for painting. Frame has _client panel for content. TabPanel manages tabs with addTab(). CheckButton extends Button. Slider uses IntChangeSignal for value changes. TextEntry stores text in char[256]. vgui_strcpy for safe string copy. Global g_api pointer provides engine functions.
directory_structure: vgui1/src/ - implementation files (.cpp), vgui1/include/ - headers (VGUI_*.h), vgui1/CMakeLists.txt - build config. CMake GLOB auto-discovers new src/*.cpp files.
